frame_mapping: Blender (x, y, z) -> Unity (x, z, y); FBX axis_forward=Z, axis_up=Y, bake_space_transform, FBX_SCALE_ALL (same as the TRAKT exterior). Unity import: Scale Factor 1, Convert Units on, Bake Axis Conversion off. Positions are in the Unity trailer frame.

origin.name: Trailer_LODn root
origin.note: ground below the kingpin = physics trailer frame (curtainsider_tridem_13_6.trailer.json: axles at negative z, kingpinHeight above the origin). Hitch: put the root so that KINGPIN coincides with the tractor socket FIFTH_WHEEL_KINGPIN.

rig_note: Flat FBX hierarchy (every part and socket is a direct child of the root), as on the tractor. All rig parents are the root: WHEEL_1L..3R spin, DOOR_RL/RR swing on the rear-post hinges, LEG_L/R translate (inner leg + sand shoe), CRANK turns, MUDFLAP_L/R swing, CURTAIN_L/R are static (separate for a later curtain-open variant). LOD1/LOD2: same parts and pivots (LOD2 has no CRANK detail beyond the arm).

tiers.texture_compression: ASTC as the tractor: C 6x6 (High) / 8x8, N 5x5 (High) / 6x6, M 8x8; power-of-two squares, mipmaps on; N and M linear, C sRGB

shader_contract.name: Kamion/TruckExterior (same contract as the tractor; Curtain is a second tinted slot)
shader_contract.uv0 'Atlas': unique atlas UV per slot; the 6 wheels share the UVs of WHEEL_1L (right side mirrored)
shader_contract.uv1 'Decal': unused (0.002, 0.002) - kept for layout parity with the tractor
shader_contract.uv2 'Data': x = light group id (light_groups), y = emissive mask (1 on lamp lenses)
shader_contract.textures: T_Trl_<Slot>_C (RGB albedo sRGB, A roughness), _N (tangent normal, OpenGL +Y), _M (R AO, G dirt mask at full strength, B metallic; Paint/Curtain: B = tint mask)
shader_contract.albedo: C.rgb; Paint: lerp(1, _PaintColor, M.b) * C.rgb; Curtain: lerp(1, _CurtainColor, M.b) * C.rgb; then lerp(albedo, _DirtColor, saturate(M.g * _Dirt))
shader_contract.emission: Lights: _LightState[uv2.x] * uv2.y (ids shared with the tractor + 13 = PLATE)
shader_contract.urp_lit_fallback: stock URP Lit: _BaseMap = T_Trl_<Slot>_BaseMap[_<livery>] (_Dirt 0.5 baked), _MetallicGlossMap and _OcclusionMap = T_Trl_<Slot>_MaskMap[_<livery>] (R metal, G AO, B dirt, A smoothness), _BumpMap = T_Trl_<Slot>_N. Loses the dirt slider and lights.
shader_contract.texel_density_note: no texel-density ADR in the repo yet (same open point as the tractor A6 README)
